title: Chance Triple Alignment: Plane, Space Station, Sun
explanation:
# A Cosmic Coincidence

In a stunning stroke of luck over the Czech Republic in June, a photographer captured the Sun with not one but two unexpected shadows crossing its face: the International Space Station and a passing airplane, creating a rare triple alignment that occurs roughly once every 30 million random photographs. The airplane's silhouette—appearing as a dark line against the brilliant solar disk—photobombed what was already a carefully timed shot of the space station, turning an impressive feat of precision into an almost impossibly rare celestial moment.
